channel.title: Industry biochem — Tejas Mahajan
channel.description: How biology and chemistry are applied in drug discovery, formulation, and biotech, and where computation fits in those pipelines.

item.title: How machine learning shows up in a drug discovery pipeline
item.description: A map of a standard small-molecule discovery pipeline, the jobs machine learning is actually asked to do along it, and a short look at related formulation problems in areas such as cosmetics.
